newsitem.title: UK: Rugby Group shares boosted by takeover.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Group shares boosted by takeover.

text.p: Shares in British building materials company Rugby Group Plc took off on Tuesday after it bought British joinery manufacturer Boulton and Paul (Holdings).
Rugby's shares rose 6p to 107p by 0905 GMT.
"Strategically it's a very good move for them," said Kevin Cammack, construction analyst at Merrill Lynch, commenting that there was over capacity in the construction sector.
"They will do their bit of rationalisation and take some of that capacity out," said the analyst.

Cammack added that despite a potential deferred payment of up to 50 million stg for Boulton and Paul, Rugby had still increased its profit-making potential. But he thought the share price would need to pause for breath, having leapt almost 10 percent since Friday.
